 Arkheron, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 and More Announced for Game Pass in November
 Aliens: Dark Descent, Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden, Generation Zero, and many more titles will also be leaving on November 30th.
 Posted By Ravi Sinha | On 18th, Nov. 2026 
 Facebook Twitter Reddit 
 Xbox has announced the second wave of titles coming to Game Pass in November, starting with Paw Patrol: Dino World , available today for Ultimate, Premium and PC subscribers. It’s joined by Call of the Elder Gods and Roadside Research , both joining Premium on cloud, Xbox Series X/S, PC, and handheld devices on November 18th.
 Black Jacket is next on November 19th, followed by Motorslice on November 24th. However, once again, they’re being added for Premium subscribers after previously debuting on Ultimate and PC. Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 also arrives next week, debuting for all three tiers for the first time.
 Fantasy PvP title Arkheron launches on November 27th and will also be available for Ultimate and PC subscribers. The Outlast Trials may have missed the Halloween window, but it will be available for all three tiers on December 1st. Considering its content updates over the past few years, it should provide a chilling time. Of course, those who want something more laid-back can check out Hela: of Mice and Magic , which launches on the same day.
 As always, however, several titles will be leaving Game Pass. Aliens: Dark Descent and Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden are perhaps the most noteworthy that won’t be available from November 30th onward. Check out the rest below:
 DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Generation Zero (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Kill It With Fire! 2 (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Moving Out 2 (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Star Trucker (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Totally Reliable Delivery Service (Cloud, Console, and PC)
